method.fact_grounding_policy: Apply original S-15/A-17/R-07 to each relevant hypothesis status used to answer the local-vs-systemic question. Existing fact IDs beside a status are insufficient when their observations do not logically justify that status. A correctly supported precursor hypothesis cannot waive an unsupported contradicted status on the competing causal explanation.
method.necessary_assumption_test: A single initiating faulty node or rack does not necessarily produce symptoms confined to that node or rack. A shared front-end/service node can produce errors on many I/O nodes. Therefore 512 emitting nodes across 32 racks contradict a one-node symptom distribution, but do not by themselves contradict a single-node initiating cause.
method.causality_policy: Read the full answer, including proposed next-check confirmation rules. A temporal-only caveat does not permit another passage to promote the same precursor to a confirmed cause.
method.no_new_requirement_or_rubric: No extra tool, minimum count, explicit repeat-citation format, new score dimension, or new threshold is introduced. The correction applies the original meaning of justified status and R-07 contradicted to the existing words and facts.
method.contextual_citation_policy: As in the first review, a status can explicitly reuse a named adjacent precursor evidence row with its real facts; the ID need not be duplicated in the same status sentence. Logical support and actual check scope are still required.
method.full_answer_reading: All text, including pre-Scope opening, background, statuses and proposed next-check interpretations, was assessed. Unsupported symptom scope and ancillary temporal mappings are not erased. A causal status must logically follow from real check facts; temporal neighbours must never be promoted to proven causes.
method.scope_boundary: The unsupported machine-wide/synchrony and unmatched-anchor mappings fail broader evidence fidelity or numerical/scope quality. In these answers, the relevant supported status is still justified by the actual6/7 temporal association, and no false mapping is used to mark a causal alternative contradicted or proven. This differs from earlier rounds, where the stated causal status itself was unjustified or a different precursor was declared another trigger.
method.r5_02_preamble_boundary: The categorical job-launched statement overinterprets the chdir message and reduces causal-separation quality. The downstream control-loss mechanism is explicitly labelled background/not log-proven, and the formal status plus next checks do not claim that temporal precedence proved it caused the control-stream failures.
method.parameter_variation: Trial2 uses a valid five-minute precursor window; trials1/3 use ten minutes. Ratios are judged against each exact receipt, not forced to match across different normalized inputs.
method.receipt_and_answer_hash_validation: Every answer SHA-256 and original receipt-file SHA-256 in all three evidence exports matched; all answer-cited fact IDs resolve in the same trial receipts.
